notes: The initial legacy live test reported valid output but failed its P95 < 333.333ms speed requirement (336.44ms). Performance is not an acceptance criterion for this change.

The final Wav2ARKit runner uses the existing live-interval functional harness for 48k mono, 16k mono and 44.1k stereo. It checks non-failed state, valid output, monotonic time and delay <= 2000ms while changing intervals; no legacy test threshold was modified.

Shipping uses NullRHI and its game loop is not capped by the supplied ExecCmds flag. Many more ticks are observed than in Editor. Timing results are diagnostic, not representative guarantees for normal rendering.
Automation warnings come from deliberate invalid bake inputs, a duplicated-audio DDC warning and the existing PIE audio-device raw-mode warning.
GPU support for Wav2ARKit, Android, prolonged physical microphone operation and perceptual lip-sync quality evaluation are outside this validation.
